description: The man wears a dark plum-purple long outer coat with gold woven borders along its open front, broad sleeve cuffs and below-knee hem. Beneath it is a cream long-sleeved tunic with a narrow upright collar, small buttons at the central opening and gold-edged cuffs. Two round gold clasps connect across the upper chest with a fine short chain. A broad gold-patterned belt with a round buckle encircles the waist, and a long decorative strap hangs centrally. Dark brown trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. His head and hands are uncovered, with no armor or weapons.
